title: Pure Dark Magician
summary: Pure Dark Magician control and Fusion strategy featuring the 2026 support wave alongside Yugi's ultimate wizard and generic staples. Led by Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant and The Gaze of Timaeus, the deck searches its signature Spells and Traps, triggers Dark Magical Circle's banish removal on summon, and fields Dark Magician the Dragon Knight and Dark Magician of Destruction.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant reveals a Spell in hand to Special Summon itself and Set a Dark Magician Spell/Trap directly from the Deck, or discards a Spell to wipe the opponent's backrow.
Magician's Rod on Normal Summon searches any Spell or Trap that specifically lists Dark Magician in its text (such as Dark Magical Circle or Soul Servant).
Illusion of Chaos reveals itself in hand to search Dark Magician or a monster mentioning it, stacking 1 card back onto the Deck.
Dark Magical Curtain allows each player to Special Summon a DARK Spellcaster from hand or Deck, searching a card that names Dark Magician if you summon the original.

summary.title: Opening: Magician's Rod + Pharaoh's Servant
steps: Normal Summon Magician's Rod and activate its effect to search Dark Magical Circle from your Deck.
Activate Dark Magical Circle to look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, adding a Dark Magician or a card mentioning it to hand and stacking the rest.

Reveal a Spell to Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your hand (it counts as Dark Magician, so Dark Magical Circle banishes a card) and Set a Spell/Trap that mentions Dark Magician from the Deck.
Activate Soul Servant, placing Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant on top of the Deck, then banish Soul Servant from GY to draw it.
Set Eternal Soul (or Magician Navigation); on the opponent's turn, activate Eternal Soul to Special Summon Dark Magician and trigger Dark Magical Circle to banish an opponent's card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: The Dark Magicians draws a card whenever a Spell or Trap card or effect is activated, and if it was a Spell/Trap, allows you to Set and activate it that turn; floats into Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl upon destruction.
Dark Magician the Dragon Knight is treated as Dark Magician and protects all your Spells and Traps from being targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects.
Dark Magician of Destruction searches a Dark Magician card upon summon and brings massive beatdown potential.
Miasma Necromancer is a Link-2 that recovers a Level 5+ DARK Spellcaster from the GY and grants an extra Normal Summon.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Eternal Soul makes all Dark Magicians in your Monster Zone unaffected by opponent card effects and Special Summons Dark Magician from hand or GY every turn.
Dark Magical Circle banishes 1 card the opponent controls whenever Dark Magician is Normal or Special Summoned to your field.

The Gaze of Timaeus shuffles a Dark Magician you control into the Deck to Fusion Summon any Fusion Monster that lists it as material (such as Dark Magician the Dragon Knight) without requiring the other material.

Soul Servant stacks a Dark Magician card from Deck or GY to the top of the Deck, and banishes itself from GY to draw cards equal to the number of Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl cards with different names on field and in GYs.
Magician's Salvation Sets Eternal Soul directly from the Deck upon activation and revives Dark Magician or Dark Magician Girl when the other is summoned.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Shining Sarcophagus engine is omitted to maintain an authentic pure Dark Magician strategy built around classic and 2026 support waves.

main: Dark Magician
The card everything here names, searches and revives.
Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant
Newest support. Counts as Dark Magician; reveals a Spell to summon itself and Set a Dark Magician card from the Deck, or discards a Spell to destroy every opposing Spell/Trap.
Magician's Rod
Normal Summoned: searches a Spell/Trap that names Dark Magician; returns to the hand on the opponent's turn.
Illusion of Chaos
Reveal it to search Dark Magician or a monster that names it; on the opponent's turn, swaps itself for Dark Magician to negate a monster effect.
Dark Magician Girl
Second target for Magician's Salvation and The Dark Magicians.
Dark Magical Circle
Digs three cards for Dark Magician or a card that names it; banishes a card whenever Dark Magician is summoned.
Dark Magical Curtain
Newest support. Each player may summon a DARK Spellcaster from the hand or Deck; if yours was Dark Magician, searches a card that names it.
The Gaze of Timaeus
Shuffles Dark Magician into the Deck to Fusion Summon a monster that names it, such as Dark Magician the Dragon Knight or Dark Magician of Destruction.
Soul Servant
Puts Dark Magician or a card that names it on top of the Deck; from the GY, draws for each Dark Magician name on the field and in the GYs.
Magician's Salvation
Field Spell: Sets Eternal Soul from the Deck, and revives Dark Magician or Dark Magician Girl when the other arrives.
Dark Magic Inheritance
Banishes two Spells from the GY to search a Spell/Trap that names Dark Magician.
Eternal Soul
Makes Dark Magician unaffected by the opponent's effects, and summons it from the hand or GY each turn.
Dark Magic Talisman
Negates a monster effect chained to a Dark Magician card, and resets itself when Dark Magician is summoned.
Magician Navigation
Summons Dark Magician from the hand and a Level 7 or lower DARK Spellcaster from the Deck; from the GY, negates a Spell/Trap.
extra: Counts as Dark Magician; summoned during a Spell turn by banishing a Level 6+ DARK Spellcaster, then searches a Dark Magician card.
Link-2 with a DARK Spellcaster: returns a Level 5+ DARK Spellcaster from the GY and gives an extra Normal Summon.
Draws on every Spell/Trap activation; destroyed, summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl.
Counts as Dark Magician and protects your Spells and Traps.
Dark Magician the Knight of Dragon Magic
Pierces and burns for the ATK of monsters it destroys.
Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight
Discards to destroy a face-up card.
